_meta.description: Quantitative targets for calendar review analysis. Example values — tune every number to your own goals and measured baselines.

zone_of_genius.metric: percentage of productive time in creative + scalable work
zone_of_genius.notes: Deep work blocks are the calendar proxy for ZoG. Actual ZoG also needs time-tracker data — this tracks the calendar-protected portion only. Baseline here is an example value.

meeting_load.metric: percentage of weekday scheduled time that is meetings

evening_cutoff.notes: No work events should end after 9pm. Affects deep sleep quality.

focus_gap_minimum.notes: Gaps under 2h are too short for deep work. For single-day mode, also report gaps >30min.

weekend_work.notes: Weekend meetings that are not gym or personal should be flagged.
